verdict.rationale: Fenwick ships client-facing software (a trademark extranet with docket management, and Fenwick Labs tools including 'intelligent alerts'), so the automation axis plausibly applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can define their own rules that trigger actions on events. The extranet's automatic synchronization and the firm-built alerts are vendor-defined behaviors, not user-configurable rules, and no API or OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
